item.title: LGFA to trial 12 playing rule enhancements
item.description: The Ladies Gaelic Football Association has confirmed that 12 playing rule enhancements will be trialled during the 2026 Lidl National Football League season and Higher Education Colleges competitions. A Special Congress will take place following the trial period to determine which rule changes will then be implemented on a permanent basis. item.title: Kerry FC announce back-of-jersey sponsorship
item.description: Kerry FC has pronounced a new jersey sponsorship with Dualcore Construction Management for the 2026 season. As part of the agreement, the Dualcore logo will feature prominently on the back of every Kerry FC jersey, positioned above the player name & number, marking the company’s first year sponsoring the club and Kerry FC’s first jersey sponsorship with an international partner. item.title: Two men remanded on bail in connection with alleged theft of mobile phones in Killarney
item.description: Two men have been remanded on bail in connection with the alleged theft of mobile phones in Killarney last Saturday night. 39-year-old Octavian Donciu of 3 Glebe House, The Lawns, Finglas, Dublin 13 and 35-year-old Catalin Peptu of 15 Knock Riada, Chapelizod, Dublin 20 appeared before Tralee District Court this morning. They were both charged with 17 counts of handling stolen property, namely mobile phones contrary to Section 17 of the Criminal Justice (Theft and Fraud Offences) Act 2001. Advert

item.title: Poulgorm Junction a "persistant issue" following petition signed by over 1,000 residents
item.description: A petition signed by over 1,000 residents highlighting a dangerous junction outside Killarney was reviewed by council members at a recent meeting of Killarney MD. Residents have voiced their concerns over the Poulgorm Junction for several reasons, including inadequate lighting, the length of the slip lane, and the speed limit on approach to the junction. The Poulgorm Junction is an intersection on the N22 road near Killarney, where the R569 Kenmare and Kilgarvan road meets the main N22. Advertis

item.title: Significant increase in number of children presenting to University Hospital Kerry with flu
item.description: There’s been a significant increase in the number of children presenting to University Hospital Kerry with the flu. Advanced Nurse Practitioner in Paediatrics at UHK, Cecilia McGarry says they’ve noticed a surge in cases among children over the past two weeks. They’ve had a range of symptoms including muscle pains, high temperatures, no appetite and the children are also lethargic. item.title: Match details announced for All Ireland football semi-finals
item.description: Match details have been announced for the All Ireland Club Football Championship semi-finals. Dingle's Senior last four outing against Ballyboden St.Endas is to be played at Pairc Ui Chaoimh at 3.15 on Saturday January 3rd. It will be preceded by An Ghaeltacht's Intermediate semi-final against Sallins, Kildare. That throws in at 1.15. Advertisement On the same day Ballymac's Junior semi against Kildare's Grangenolvin will go ahead in Mick Neville Park at 2.
